solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Try a measure of spirits

definitions.meaning: to have a go or an attempt at something
a single small serving of whisky or vodka

explanation.surface: An invitation to sample a dram of something strong.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms: a go or attempt, and a small glass of liquor poured at the bar.

clue.text: Her slot designed as gun holder

indicators.note: designed means the letters of her slot are arranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A woman's slot has been made into a sheath for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: A leather case worn on a belt or shoulder to carry a pistol is exactly a holder for a gun.

clue.text: Watch, say, construction of mitre

indicators.note: construction of means the letters of mitre are built up in a different order

explanation.surface: A wristwatch, perhaps, made out of a bishop's hat.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'say' marks a watch as one example of a device that measures time.
explanation.definitionFit: A watch is one example of a clock-like device for measuring elapsed time.

clue.text: The pics, a strange compilation from various sources

indicators.note: strange means the letters of the pics, a are put in an odd new order

explanation.surface: A collage of photographs looks like an odd assortment gathered from everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastiche in art or music is a medley imitating or combining elements borrowed from several works.

clue.text: Period of rest coming up for God

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a nap is a short sleep or rest

explanation.surface: A spell of rest is approaching for some deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Pan is the Greek deity of shepherds and wild places, a goat-legged figure of myth.

clue.text: Vessel in superficial glare of publicity

indicators.note: in says the vessel word is placed inside the word for superficial

parts.note: a slight wound or interest is a superficial one
a pot is a vessel for cooking or holding liquid

explanation.surface: A shallow ship caught briefly in the media's harsh attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the public eye under intense media attention is a common idiom from the theatre's bright beam.

clue.text: Prisoners recollected its name

indicators.note: recollected, read as re-collected, means the letters of its name are gathered up again in a new order

explanation.surface: Jailed men remembered what something was called.
explanation.definitionFit: Inmates are people confined in a prison or institution, so prisoners is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Hoedown's beginning on float

indicators.note: beginning means only the opening letter of hoedown's is taken

parts.note: on can mean over, as in a lid on or over a jar

explanation.surface: A square dance's opening lingers on a parade float.
explanation.definitionFit: To hover is to float or hang in the air without moving away.

clue.text: Bird, wretched duck!

parts.note: flaming is a mild British oath meaning damned or wretched, as in 'that flaming car'
in cricket a duck is a score of zero, so it gives the letter O

explanation.surface: An exasperated shout at a miserable waterfowl.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes 'duck' the bird; it is the cricket zero, while the bird is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall pink wading creature with long legs, found in lagoons, is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Entering Malmo, vehicles advance

indicators.note: entering means the letters sit inside the words Malmo, vehicles, spanning the gap between them

explanation.surface: Cars driving into the Swedish city make progress.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance is to go forward, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Famous traitors sent back

indicators.note: sent back means the word for traitors is written in reverse

parts.note: rats is slang for traitors or informers

explanation.surface: Notorious turncoats are being deported.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, as in a headline performer or player, the word means celebrated or leading.

clue.text: One confused royalist!

indicators.note: confused means the letters of royalist are jumbled up

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a single muddled supporter of the crown.
explanation.definitionFit: Something alone or single is just one, so a lone individual fits this adjective.

clue.text: Past moves in polished comedy routines

indicators.note: in says the shuffled letters go inside the word for polished

parts.note: a slick performance is smooth and polished

indicators.note: moves means the letters of past are rearranged

explanation.surface: Old changes have produced well-honed comic acts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' is the anagram signal, not part of the surface's sense of change; 'Past' is the fodder, not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapstick is boisterous physical comedy of pratfalls and custard pies, a kind of comic routine.

clue.text: Atrocity west of a peninsula in old war

indicators.note: in an across clue, west of means the first piece is written to the left of the next

parts.note: an atrocity is a terrible crime

explanation.surface: A massacre took place on a headland during a historic conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: The Black Sea landmass gave its name to the 1850s war between Russia and Britain, France and Turkey.

clue.text: Parent with very difficult dog

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother, a parent
a stiff test or climb is a very difficult one

explanation.surface: A mother with an awkward hound.
explanation.definitionFit: A mastiff is a large powerful breed of dog used as a guard.

clue.text: Type of music for Mark or John

definitions.meaning: a style of Christian religious song from African-American churches
each is one of the four New Testament books telling the life of Jesus

explanation.surface: A musical genre is chosen for two men named Mark and John.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the religious vocal genre; the other is the New Testament accounts named after evangelists.

clue.text: Horrendous sight was witnessed by me, it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals that the words are spoken, and the sound matches another spelling

parts.note: if something was witnessed by me then I saw it

explanation.surface: Someone describes a shocking spectacle they personally watched.
explanation.definitionFit: An ugly building or object that spoils a view is an unsightly blot, a horrendous sight.

clue.text: All men on board, in black and white?

definitions.text: All men on board, in black and white?

parts.words: All men on board, in black and white?
parts.note: the men are game pieces on a board, coloured black and white, rather than sailors aboard a ship

explanation.surface: A ship's crew all aboard, perhaps dressed in monochrome uniforms.
explanation.definitionFit: A full collection of the thirty-two pieces for the board game, split into dark and light sides.

clue.text: Doubly hard to catch swallow in wasteland

indicators.note: to catch means the two outer letters hold the swallow word between them
doubly means the abbreviation for hard is written twice

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
to swallow food is to eat it

explanation.surface: It is hard to catch a swallow flying over barren ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swallow' looks like the bird but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A heath is an open stretch of uncultivated land covered with heather and scrub.

clue.text: Look back and forth

definitions.note: a quick furtive glance gives the four-letter word that is a palindrome, so it reads the same either way

indicators.note: back and forth says the word spells the same in either direction

parts.note: a quick furtive glance gives the four-letter word that is a palindrome, so it reads the same either way

explanation.surface: Glance behind you and ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a quick, furtive glance is a synonym for a brief look.

clue.text: Level playing field

definitions.meaning: a ground marked out for football or cricket

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a degree or height of intensity; the other is a sports ground, as a football or cricket field.

clue.text: Hired vehicle: duty to take one

parts.note: a duty is a tax levied on goods
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cab is hired, and a levy must be paid to ride.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab you pay to ride in is a car hired for the journey.

clue.text: Not doing anything interesting initially, I cannot elaborate

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of interesting is used
elaborate means the letters of I cannot are worked into a more intricate order

explanation.surface: Someone idle says there is nothing of note to report and they won't expand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elaborate' rearranges I CANNOT into NACTION, after the I from 'interesting initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Idleness or a lack of activity is a state of doing nothing at all.

clue.text: A US city, no matter which

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York

explanation.surface: Pick any American city at random.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as a determiner, the word means whichever one you choose, without restriction.

clue.text: Hours of work important for device on computer

parts.note: a shift is a set period of working hours
a key factor is an important one

explanation.surface: Time spent working matters for a gadget on the PC.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the button on a keyboard held down to type capitals, a device on a computer.

clue.text: Lean over part of foot

definitions.meaning: of a ship, to tilt or list to one side
the rounded back end below the ankle

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a boat tilting to one side; the other is the back of the foot below the ankle.
